There's a line in the Old Testament most people read past: "It is I who gives you the power to get wealth." Not "I give you wealth." The power to create it.

That's the whole difference. The power comes from one source — call it God, the universe, infinite intelligence, oneness, whatever word fits you. Let it move through you and you have the power to create and manifest your life, not just your bank account.

Most people never got handed wealth. They got handed power and didn't recognize it.

Comment RISE and I'll send you how to use what you were actually given.

You don't have to choose between a mansion and being enlightened. That choice was never real.

A fully spiritual, awakened person can sit in a Rolls Royce and still be one with the universe. The material things were never the obstacle. Renouncing the world was never required.

Every material thing — the car, the watch, your own body — is an extension of the same one consciousness everything comes from. Reject the physical world and you're rejecting a piece of what you already are.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the part most teachers leave out.

Every time you hand the government a little more control, it's wrapped in a reason that sounds reasonable: safety, security, protection.

But reliance is the actual transaction. The more you lean on something outside yourself for the basics, the more of your own power you sign away, one small convenience at a time, until you look up and realize you don't have much control left at all.

That trade has a name. It's not an accident that no one calls it that out loud.

Most people have the order backwards. They think: have something, then you'll finally get to be happy, confident, whatever it is.

It runs the other way. Being comes first. Being is what leads to doing. Doing is what leads to having. Skip the first step and the other two just collapse.

The superior man looks within for the answer. Most people only ever look outside — at other people, other circumstances, anything but themselves.
